artworks.title: -Qu'est-ce vous voulez?  -Les "louis" de 1871
artworks.medium: brush and black ink and black crayon on laid Van Gelder paper
artworks.description: The image depicts two individuals shown from head to toe. On the left, a person standing upright with their body facing forward but the head turned to the right, and hands behind their back. This person is wearing a helmet, long coat, and boots. On the right, another person standing with a slightly hunched posture, looking intently towards the person on the left. This person has more pronounced facial features with an open mouth and squinted eyes, wearing a spiked headdress, long robe, and bare feet. The surroundings are minimal with indistinct shapes resembling stones or rubble at the ankles of the second person, and an undefined form to the right of them. The background is a blank, textured surface, and the entire scene is sketched with loose, expressive lines.

artworks.title: Poilu Acknowledging German Soldier
artworks.medium: black crayon on laid paper
artworks.description: The drawing depicts two figures in conversation. One figure is seated on the left, wearing a helmet and coat, while the other stands on the right, wearing a cap and uniform. The background features loosely drawn lines hinting at a landscape. The sketch emphasizes expressive lines, focusing on the essential features of the figures. Shadows and textures are created through cross-hatching and smudging techniques.

artworks.title: L'heure des gothas
artworks.medium: black crayon and brush and black ink, with corrections by the artist in white opaque watercolor, on wove paper
artworks.description: This image shows a seated person holding a baby in their arms. The person is sitting on a chair, facing the baby with a gentle expression. The person has a bun hairstyle and is wearing a long dress with a shawl. The baby is wrapped in a patterned blanket. Next to them is a detailed bassinet or crib. The background includes a window and a faint hint of outdoors, and there is a small object, possibly a toy, on the floor.

artworks.title: Grace!
artworks.medium: brush and black ink and black crayon on laid paper
artworks.description: The image shows a person in a crawling position on the ground. The person's body is visible, with hands and knees touching the ground. The person's head is tilted back, mouth open. The facial features include an open mouth, but no other details are discernible. The person wears a helmet with a small protrusion and loose-fitting clothing. There are no visible jewelry or objects. The background is sparse with faint lines suggesting an open landscape with vague shapes in the distance, creating a sense of openness.

artworks.title: News in the Trenches
artworks.medium: black crayon and brush and black ink on wove paper
artworks.description: The image depicts a soldier in a crouched position. The soldier is hunched forward with bent knees, suggesting caution or taking cover. He wears a military helmet and uniform, holding a long object, possibly a rifle. Vague impressions of other soldiers or figures are behind him, with clouds or smoke on the right side. The background is lightly sketched, conveying a battlefield environment. The artwork is monochromatic with shading and minimal lines for dramatic effect.

artworks.title: a) Versailles juillet.  La Germania signe... (recto); b) Sketch for Figure of Germania (verso)
artworks.medium:
a) black crayon and brown wash on wove paper
b) black crayon on wove paper
artworks.description: The image shows a sketch with two figures. The figure on the left is depicted from the waist up, with long hair falling over one shoulder. They are dressed in a sleeveless garment. The figure on the right is seated, has a bald head, distinct facial features, and wears a dark suit. They are holding what appears to be a large bird. The background is plain with minimal sketch lines, and there are inscriptions in the upper left and below the figures.

artworks.title: Ceux de la premiere heure.  "Sire! ou en somme-nous de "la guerre fraiche et joyeuse"? ..."
artworks.medium: black crayon on wove paper
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a figure draped in a flowing cloak. The sketch is minimalistic, using simple pencil lines and shading to depict the voluminous folds of a cloak worn by a bent-over figure. The background features subtle, sketchy lines suggesting a ground or surface, as well as some abstract circular shapes. The drawing captures movement and dynamic force with its use of lines and texture, showcasing the energy and grace of the subject.

artworks.title: A Versailles juillet 1919
artworks.medium: brush and black ink and black crayon on wove paper
artworks.description: The sketch primarily shows two individuals with a focus on their upper bodies. On the left, a man with short hair and a mustache is depicted looking downward, possibly writing or reading. To his right, another man is leaning on a barrier or low wall. The background suggests an audience or crowd, with curved lines and some indistinct detailing resembling trees or structural elements.

artworks.title: Prussian Soldier and Civilians
artworks.medium: black crayon and brush and black ink on laid Van Gelder paper
artworks.description: The image shows a sketch with two half-body representations of people. On the left, a person is leaning forward with their head slightly bowed, wearing a coat with a rounded collar. Their face is partially turned downward and they have short hair. On the right, another person is standing upright with their hands behind their back, wearing a helmet with a spike and a stylized mustache. The background is simple with a few horizontal lines, and there is an artist's signature in the bottom right corner.

artworks.title: a) After Douai (recto); b) Untitled (verso)
artworks.medium:
a) brush with brown and black ink and black crayon on laid paper
b) black crayon on laid paper
artworks.description: The image shows two women in motion facing each other. The woman on the right stands upright, with long flowing hair and distinct facial features. She wears a flowing garment sketched in dark lines. The woman on the left is slightly bent, looking up at the other woman, partially obscured by a head covering. She also wears a flowing dress. The background includes simple outlines of buildings, rooftops and chimneys. The scene conveys a dynamic interaction between the two figures against a sparse backdrop.

artworks.title: Lost Illusions
artworks.medium: black crayon and brush and black ink on wove paper
artworks.description: The image is a sketch of two individuals. One person is lying on the ground, partly obscured by lines and shapes indicating debris. The other person is standing, leaning forward with one arm extended downward. They are wearing a hard hat and work attire. Facial features of the standing person, such as a beard, are visible. The background is minimally sketched.

artworks.title: After Douai
artworks.medium: brush and black ink on laid paper
artworks.description: This is a drawing of two figures against a backdrop of a town with a church steeple. The drawing captures a scene in which one figure appears to comfort or support the other. The lines are expressive, using light and dark contrasts for movement and emotion. The background shows the outline of a town with buildings and a church steeple, suggesting a village or town setting. The use of space and line creates a narrative moment blending the figures' interaction with their surroundings in a minimalistic style.

artworks.title: The Departure for Versailles
artworks.medium: brush and brown ink and graphite on laid paper
artworks.description: The image shows a person seated and leaning slightly forward. They have a focused expression and are wearing a head covering. Their clothing includes layered garments, with the outer layer resembling a cloak. Next to them is a bag or suitcase. In the background, there is a faint sketch of another figure standing behind the seated person, holding a bag. The background is a light, uniform color.

artworks.title: Le retour du permissionnaire.  -Tu Tombes a pie!
artworks.medium: black and orange crayon and brush and black ink on wove paper

artworks.title: a) Si ils avaient vaincu (recto); b) Sketch of Si ils avaient vaincu (verso)
artworks.medium:
a) brush and black ink on laid Van Gelder paper
b) brush and black ink on laid Van Gelder paper
artworks.description: The image shows a sketch of five figures' upper bodies. The central figure on the right wears a uniform with a plumed helmet and has a broad mustache. To the left are four smaller figures, depicted with only their heads and shoulders. The facial features are detailed with shading to express various emotions. The figures are cloaked in loose garments, with some holding their heads in their hands. The background is minimalistic, with lightly sketched lines hinting at a vast, open space or distant structures. The sketch is in black ink on a beige surface, emphasizing the expressive nature of the figures.

artworks.title: a) Along the Marne (recto); b) Study for Along the Marne (verso)
artworks.medium:
a) black crayon with graphite and red and yellow crayon additions on wove paper
b) black crayon on wove paper
artworks.description: The image shows a figure standing on the right side. The horizon is a third from the top of the composition. Hills extend across the landscape. The brushstrokes suggest a sketch-like technique with swift lines. The color palette is monochrome with shades of gray, and subtle touches of red and orange. A person is depicted close by with sparse detail and rocks are scattered further away. Soft hills and a faint suggestion of a structure or more rocks are in the distance. The scene is simple, focusing on lines and minimal shading to suggest form and space.

artworks.title: Germania before the Judges
artworks.medium: black crayon and brush and black ink on laid paper
artworks.description: The image shows a person standing with their head slightly bowed and looking downwards. The individual is on the left side of the sketch, with their body turned slightly to the side. Their facial features are simple and stylized, with a pronounced frown or furrowed brow, and they have long hair partially covering their face. They wear a long garment, possibly a robe, with a head covering that has a pointed top. The person is holding something in their right hand. To the right side of the image, there is a group of loosely sketched figures standing close together, wearing hats or helmets. The background is plain, with no defined elements, focusing attention on the central figure and the group to the side.

artworks.title: The Empire Destroys, The Republic Pays
artworks.medium: black crayon and brush and black ink on laid paper
artworks.description: The artwork features two figures sketched in black charcoal on a light background. The central figure is depicted from approximately the waist down in a dynamic pose, bending over with one arm extended. The clothing appears bulky, and is detailed with various lines and shading for texture. The lower part of the figure is dressed in pants with knee-high boots. To the right, a secondary figure is seated in a relaxed pose, partially obscured and sketched with less detail. The background is mostly empty, except for some hints of debris or ruins towards the left side, suggested by angular shapes. The overall composition conveys movement and context without specific facial details or intricate settings.

artworks.title: Toward Peace
artworks.medium: black crayon and brush with black and brown ink on wove paper
artworks.description: The drawing shows three full-body figures in an outdoor setting. On the left, a person is standing in profile view facing two men with their arms crossed. The person has their hair pulled back, possibly in a bun, wearing a long, loose garment with a sash tied around the waist and a draped piece on the back. To the right, the two men are standing next to each other, facing the figure on the left. Both men wear military-style caps and uniforms with overcoats draped over them. The background features rough sketches indicating a ruined or rocky landscape with outlines of arch structures or scattered debris, suggesting ruins or a desolate area.

artworks.title: C'est la, que j'ai fini le cure
artworks.medium: pen and brown ink with brown wash over black crayon on wove paper
artworks.description: This drawing is a sketch depicting several faint shapes and outlines. On the left is a man in profile, looking up and to the right with his hands in his pockets. The man has pale skin and a dark beard and mustache, and he wears a flat cap and a long-sleeved shirt or jacket. To the right, there appears to be a pole with the legs of another person hanging from the top. The man appears to be looking up at this hanging figure. Behind this scene are more pencil outlines that may indicate other people or objects. The background is beige paper.

artworks.title: a) In the Trenches (recto); b) Study for In the Trenches (verso)
artworks.medium:
a) black crayon with black and grey wash on wove paper
b) black crayon and brush and black ink on wove paper
artworks.description: The image is a pencil drawing depicting two full-length figures in an outdoor setting. The figures are positioned side by side, facing towards the left. Both figures are wearing hats, one with a broad brim and the other a rounded cap. They are wearing loose, coat-like clothing with minimal facial details. The first figure carries a crossbody bag. The ground and distant background are minimally sketched with rough strokes, suggesting a landscape with hills and two rectangular shapes that could represent buildings or signs.

artworks.title: Poilu and Tommy Conversing
artworks.medium: brush and black ink with watercolor over graphite on laid paper
artworks.description: The image shows two individuals, one standing and leaning forward, the other seated on the ground with their right knee drawn up. The standing person wears a helmet and a long coat, carrying a large backpack or equipment. The seated person wears a cap and a uniform, engaged in conversation with the standing figure. The background is minimal, with an off-white canvas.

artworks.title: Hospital Scene
artworks.medium: brush and black ink on wove paper
artworks.description: The image depicts two people in different positions, one seated in bed while the other stands beside them. The standing figure has a tilted head and bold, dark hair, wearing loose clothing. Another person in profile wears a head covering, with a cup or bowl on a nearby surface. The background is minimalistic, keeping the attention on the figures.

artworks.title: 7me 1914
artworks.medium: brush and black ink and black crayon on wove paper
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a figure leaning forward and holding a rifle in a stark landscape. The drawing is executed in charcoal or pencil with strong, dynamic lines conveying a sense of motion. The figure is advancing through a flat, barren land with details like a plume of smoke in the background. The line work is simple, contrasting with the detailed shading on the figure's clothing and equipment. The landscape is sparse with minimal lines indicating the horizon. The composition focuses on the solitary figure, using negative space to evoke a sense of isolation or urgency.
